DrPanda MCP 1.9.0 — Nacos scope modes and probe fix.

- Nacos data_scope/service_scope: all or selected; all is bounded by authorized namespaces/groups.
- New targets default all; legacy targets without a mode stay selected to avoid silent privilege expansion.
- Multi-namespace/group connection probes now choose an authorized scope instead of failing.
- Nacos 3 all-scope list limitation is reported explicitly.
- No database migration.

DrPanda MCP 1.8.0 — per-target operator notes.

- Add targets.operator_notes (up to 512 chars) via migration 0014.
- systems_status target rows and target-specific tool results return the full operator_notes field.
- Notes are advisory only: they never change scope, read-only rules, or guard decisions.
- Web form field with validation and warning not to store secrets.
- MySQL/PostgreSQL integration migration checks updated.

No breaking changes.

DrPanda MCP 1.7.0 — read-only Jenkins component.

- New jenkins target type using the Jenkins REST API.
- Tools: jenkins_jobs, jenkins_job, jenkins_builds, jenkins_build, jenkins_console, jenkins_nodes, jenkins_queue.
- API token authentication, TLS CA, exact job/node allowlists, optional console access and bounded build/log sizes.
- Real Jenkins 2.541.3 Docker verification covering Basic auth, API token, job, build, console, node and queue.
- No database changes.

DrPanda MCP 1.6.0 — Nacos 3.x support.

- Adds a v3 client adapter selected automatically or via api_version (auto/v1/v3).
- Supports v3 config reads, scope-derived config/service listing, and v3 instance discovery without requiring Nacos admin APIs.
- Preserves Nacos 1.x/2.x v1 behavior and adds 3.0.2 Docker verification plus 2.2.3 regression coverage.
- No database changes.

DrPanda MCP 1.5.1 — Nacos auth verification and token TTL fix.

- Fixed accessToken caching so short server TTLs are not exceeded.
- Verified Nacos 2.2.3 auth: default/custom users, namespace/group ACL, wrong-password classification.
- Verified Nacos 1.4.2 auth, TLS-terminated auth chain, and documented Nacos 3.x v3 API differences/current unsupported boundary.
- Added verification record and short-TTL regression test.

No database changes.

- CLS SearchLog rows now prefer LogJson and RawLog before Log/Content, so searches no longer return empty content.

- Added regression coverage for the LogJson response shape.
